card.name: Inside pathology and tissue-change terms
card.fires_on: Fires on the break inside words like "pathologic" ("path"/"ologic") and on words just before tissue-disease terms, such as "nodular", "benign" or "portal". Also on a "<" sign before a percentage.

modes.label: Inside pathologic
modes.description: The word "pathologic" split into parts, after "other" or "interstitial".
modes.example: Uptake of Detectnet can be seen in a variety of tumor types other than NETs, in other<< path>>ologic conditions

modes.label: Before tissue-disease words
modes.description: Adjectives or word starts that lead into liver or prostate findings.
modes.example: males with<< benign>> prostatic hypertrophy are at particular risk

modes.label: Cutoff values
modes.description: A less-than sign or number in a lab threshold.
modes.example: If marrow cellularity is<< <>>10%, interrupt treatment with Dasatin
